fact: On 30 April 2026 ACSI presented the Plateforme de Dématérialisation des Recettes des Collectivités Locales (PDRCL) to the mayor of Brazzaville as a platform that is to replace manual methods of collecting municipal taxes and fees, recording each transaction in real time from collectors' mobile terminals with a dashboard for the municipal authority; the text speaks of its implementation as still to come and does not say the town hall uses it.
title: Présentation de la plateforme PDRCL à la Mairie de Brazzaville par l’ACSI
